c3_r2c.x: C1's R2_c without nulls (T's interior, the K_P mean)

analysis.containment: a descriptive that raises is recorded as {'error': '<type>: <message>'} (analysis.guarded); C1, C2, C2-sw, C3-w, C3-R2c and the decision rules of C1-pattern, C1-own, value accuracy, C1-limit and C1-braking raise; a network that failed K3 after the tag (critic.k3_trained) decides nothing, so its whole analysis or description is contained

value_accuracy.fit: out of fold: C1's per-fold affine calibration (slope >= 0) on the frozen folds, key weights on the rows
value_accuracy.rows_are: T's interior restarts every 20th step and D (every key's t = 0); crashed runs recorded and dropped
value_accuracy.target_is: the deterministic policy's own discounted return (own.own_return: delta = 0, s_stop = +inf)

k3_trained.extractor_is: max |extractor - Flax| in float64 of the actor's mean (Actor.apply), the critic's V and heads (Critic.apply(with_heads=True)), by both extractors
k3_trained.fail: its C1, C1-heads, C1-own (and held form), C1-pattern, C1-limit, C1-braking, W1, C2 and C2-sw descriptive ('K3 trained check failed: ...'); missing from every decision it enters (per network, the variants, C3-w, C3-R2c); its whole analysis or description contained (analysis.guarded)
k3_trained.float32_is: max |V64 - V32| in the critic's units; V32: RunningMeanStd.normalize and Critic.apply in float32 (x64 off) on the observation rounded to float32

gates.band_note_scope: C2's records only (the primary, each variant, each strata row): both notes were measured on C2's setup, and C2-sw's sigma^ped is not residualised

c2_null.rule: descriptive: C2's primary statistic of each seed's random-init actor (G1's architecture and obs_rms) as the network against the control pool with the two-level CI, as the probes stage scores a trained network; the summary frozen and printed beside each primary C2; no decision reads it

decoy_k_stage.rule: pass: decoy_k_choice on this world's validation seeds gives states.knn_k (not a blocker) and every per-seed Delta2, paired and unpaired, is within reproduce_tol of states.knn_k_validation

gates.k4_no_gain_rule: a plant's effect is the change it causes in the same network: PR-2 (both variants), PR-3's grouped split, PR-6, PR-6b and PR-6c (with their residualisation-off checks and planted faults) are scored by the paired increment: Delta2(host + plant) - Delta2(host), the same host, random controls, rows, components and bootstrap draws (a paired bootstrap for the CI), tolerances, seeds and every-seed rules unchanged; the unpaired values and the host's own offset per plant and per seed are recorded, descriptive; PR-1a, PR-1b, PR-5, PR-8 and PR-3's mis-grouped leak check keep their rules (the leak's paired value reported)
gates.k4_pr1b_rule: PR-1b's baseline, plant, probe and random controls on one target array, each row's own-fold lambda_res; every K_P component planted at once; the plant on C2's by-fold targets reported beside it, descriptive
gates.k4_pr4_rule: PR-4 one-sided: h2's and h3's R2 each >= the readout's R2 - k4[3] (the probe on either layer also sees its other units and can exceed the readout)

k4_pr6.oversmooth_k_rule: the planted fault's k is min(oversmooth_k, the smallest training set of states.cross_fit's fits); descriptive

gates.k4_pr6_rule: PR-6: Delta2 <= k4[2] (one-sided) on C2's by-fold lambda_res with K4's controls, the decoy units' gain the grid's whose probe-alone R2 lies closest to the decoy kNN's, and PR-1b passing; PR-6b (smooth F) and PR-6c (F the leave-one-geometry-out k = 15 kNN of lambda on D1): y = std(F) + noise AR(1) eps, the units holding F appended to h3, y residualised by states.cross_fit at states.knn_k; C2's primary statistic (its decision rows, power floor and 5 random-init controls) <= k4[2] on every seed, > k4[2] on every seed with the residualisation off, and for PR-6b the units' probe-alone R2 >= the kNN's on every seed; K4 needs both; every Delta2 here is k4_no_gain_rule's paired increment

nulls.per_fold_rule: [F, n, 8]: slice f built without fold f, cross-fitted as C2's decoys (value fits: fold f's rows through the fit without fold f, a training row of fold g through the fit without folds f and g at fold f's penalty, one fit per pair of folds and penalty; far geometry: neither fold f nor the row's own fold); fold f's calibration fitted on slice f's training rows, predicting fold f from slice f
nulls.uncalibrated_rows: C1, C1-pattern, C1-limit, W1 and C3-w's x: a row whose fold has no calibration is dropped and counted, never scored; none left: 'not testable' (C3-w: the network missing)
nulls.value_mlp_nested_seed: mlp_rng(partition, a, 99, N_INNER + 1 + b) for the fit without folds a < b

five_controls.rule: the median over the random-init controls; the geometry-cluster bootstrap with the controls fixed (descriptive: decides nothing)
five_controls.scope: every other C2 and C2-sw record: the sensitivity and robustness variants, the robustness summary and the strata tables' rows but each table's primary row

c2_pool.k4: unchanged: K4's plants keep their own controls (gates.k4_controls of the 5; PR-6b and PR-6c the 5) and paired increments
c2_pool.rule: the median over the pool of random-init controls; a two-level percentile bootstrap: each draw resamples the geometry clusters and, independently (stream costate_c2_pool), the controls with replacement
c2_pool.scope: the primary C2 and C2-sw of each decision network (the records that enter network_decisions and R18); the network's rank among the pool's control gains beside each (descriptive)

logo.records: each set's point, move, CI and decision, the most influential geometry and its move, and each geometry's share of the weight and of the base's (C2, C2-sw) or the network's and the target's (C1) squared error
logo.rule: the single-geometry robustness rule: the decision is recomputed on each leave-one-geometry-out scoring set (the geometry's rows weighted 0 in scoring; fits, calibrations, out-of-fold predictions, nulls and controls unchanged), its CI the same bootstrap over the other G - 1 geometries (stream costate_logo, sub-stream the geometry, N_BOOT draws; a two-level CI keeps the pool's control draws); a confirm or refute stands only if every set's decision is the same, otherwise it is 'inconclusive' (reason 'geometry-sensitive', the geometries named, the full-set decision kept as 'decision_all_geometries'); an inconclusive full-set decision stays inconclusive
logo.scope: the primary C1, C2 and C2-sw of each decision network (the records that enter network_decisions and R18; C1's label 'at scale' needs the ruled confirm) and K4's PR-5, whose rules read the ruled decisions; C3-w and C3-R2c are across networks and exempt; the strata tables' rows, the sensitivity variants and the descriptive networks' C1 carry the sets' points only ('summary', descriptive)

probes.wiring_rule: K5: while each outer fold is held out, the training targets permuted state by state across all training rows (the mirror-odd components within turn direction, the others across both; stream costate_perm, sub-streams (draw, f, j)); the out-of-fold predictions of wiring[0] draws averaged and scored by R2_wd against the unpermuted held-out targets; every K_P component needs a cluster-bootstrap CI lower end <= 0 and a point <= wiring[1]

states.knn_k_rule: f_D's one k (knn_k) for every fit, partition, outer fold and K_P component, chosen before the tag on synthetic known truth only (gates.decoy_k_choice): among knn_k_candidates the largest k for which every validation seed (knn_k_validation) of K4's PR-6b and PR-6c worlds gives C2's primary Delta2 <= gates.k4[2], y residualised at k and C2's power floor recomputed at k; none: the smallest, a blocker; the Delta2 read is the units' paired increment over their host (gates.k4_no_gain_rule). Grounds: what leaks into C2 is f_D's bias, which a network holding the decoy function recovers; its variance only costs power, so an out-of-geometry SSE, which trades the two, does not choose k

knn_k_validation.statistic: paired increment: Delta2(host + plant) - Delta2(host), the same host, random controls, rows, components and bootstrap draws

targets.k1_rule: K1's zero threshold and denominator floor eps_t = max(zero_atol, 6 kink_j_noise / (h gamma^t)) (gates.k1_error; on the pedal-saturated ladder the rungs' J spread where it exceeds kink_j_noise); zero comparisons counted per component, plant and reading, never pooled, and a decided component needs a non-zero one; a kink: |forward - backward| > kink_factor max(discrepancy, 6 kink_j_noise / (h gamma^t)); c / 10 at most max_shrink times while the Richardson pair disagrees by more than shrink_rtol |FD| and 6 kink_j_noise / (h gamma^t), and still so: unresolved, not counted, in the 30% share; pi_1 (targets.fd_pi at pi_h) under the same zero rule with eps = max(zero_atol, 6 kink_j_noise / (pi_h gamma)), its plants' comparisons too: pi needs a non-zero comparison and each pi plant must fail on its non-zero ones; zero_atol alone in the reported 'design_rule'
